svg.aria-label: NFCtron. CISO and Head of Development. Cashless payments, ticketing and event management for live events across Europe. Own security, risk, incident response and compliance with PCI and the card schemes; led PCI DSS 4.0.1, MPoC, scheme certifications and external pentests of our terminal. Secure NFCtron Pay: Tap to Pay on Android, terminals, key management and its cloud. Lead development of the platform: payments, ticketing, billing, bank payouts, point of sale and mobile apps. Build NFCtron Nebula, our prepaid card program, with identity checks (KYC). Bring AI agents into the team’s daily work, from internal assistants to coding agents. Bianca: POS mobile app for the fastest, most secure payments at events. Also runs ticketing check-in and access control. Tickets: Web event ticketing, seat reservation and cashless top-up. Hub: The motherboard of the NFCtron ecosystem and the B2B home for organizers, sellers and partners. API: The backbone that connects every NFCtron product to the world and to each other, fast, secure and scalable. Mobile apps: B2C Android and iOS apps for attendees, and soon for our payment cardholders. Nautilus: Our own fully certified, PCI compliant SoftPOS mobile terminal, with a Terminal Management System. Nebula: Card Management System for our own NFCtron payment cards, backed by an issuing license.
